title: is_complete() false-positive with auto-totalled single part
description: PartCollection::new() doc does not warn that adding part 1 auto-bumps total to 1, making is_complete() return true immediately. Callers who use new() without a known total and then call is_complete() will get a false true. Add a warning to the PartCollection::new() and is_complete() doc comments.
close_reason: Fixed: added is_complete() and new() doc warnings about auto-inferred total causing false-positive is_complete.
